'''Palso Thern''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Thern was assigned to [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron]] under the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] [[Blue Seven/Legends|Blue Seven]]. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Thern attended a briefing held on the Alliance's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|Star Cruiser]] [[Home One/Legends|''Home One'']], during which [[Supreme Commander (Alliance)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] discussed the plan to attack the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] over [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. Thern then piloted a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] as part of the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|contingent]] that [[Battle of Endor/Legends|attacked]] the Imperial battlestation.

==Biography==
Palso Thern, a [[Human/Legends|Human]], was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="ROTJ" /> Thern served in [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron]] under the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] [[Blue Seven/Legends|Blue Seven]].<ref name="Hasbro" /> Shortly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="ROTJ" /> in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> Thern was present during the briefing on the Rebel [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 ''Home One'' type Star Cruiser]] [[Home One/Legends|''Home One'']], where the Alliance's [[Supreme Commander (Alliance)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] announced that the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Rebel fleet]] would attack the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]].<ref name="ROTJ" /> During the battle that followed, Thern was among the [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilots]] who engaged the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial fleet]]<ref name="Hasbro" /> over the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. The [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] was led by<ref name="ROTJ novel">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi'' novelization]]</ref> [[Merrick Simms]],<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> who was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the conflict. Following Simms' death, Blue Squadron joined [[Gold Leader/Legends|Gold Leader]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] on the latter's attack run on the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]], but later broke off from the attack in order to distract the pursuing [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]]. The battle ended with a victory for the Rebel Alliance, and the destruction of the second Death Star.<ref name="ROTJ novel" />

==Personality and traits==
Palso Thern had [[Color/Legends|blond]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]],<ref name="ROTJ" /> blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]],<ref name="Hasbro" /> and light skin. Thern was among the elite pilots who had bravery, skill, and loyalty to the Rebel Alliance. Thern and the other pilots had a chief goal of victory during the Battle of Endor. Knowing they were deciding the future of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], Thern and the other pilots did everything to complete their mission.<ref name="Hasbro" />

==Equipment==
Thern wore a red [[Flight suit/Legends|flight suit]]<ref name="ROTJ" /> and a [[Armor/Legends|helmet]], and wielded a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]].<ref name="Hasbro" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Palso_Thern_SW_Facebook.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Palso Thern on ''Home One'' in ''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']]
Palso Thern was created for the original trilogy film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], in which the character was portrayed by an uncredited extra.<ref name="ROTJ" /> Thern first appeared in the film's [[Return of the Jedi: The Storybook Based on the Movie|storybook]] written by [[Joan D. Vinge]]<ref name="Storybook">''[[Return of the Jedi: The Storybook Based on the Movie]]''</ref> and released on [[May 12]], [[1983]],<ref name="Amazon UK-Paperback">{{Amazon|domain=co.uk|url=Return-Jedi-Storybook-Publisher-Publications/dp/B00SLU9N04|text=Return of the Jedi: Storybook: Written by Joan D. Vinge, 1983 Edition, Publisher: Futura Publications (Paperback)}}</ref> before the film's release on [[May 25]], 1983.<ref name="Year">''[[Star Wars Year by Year: A Visual Chronicle]]''</ref> Thern was eventually identified and given an action figure in the "Battle Over Endor" set of [[2010]]'s ''[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Dark Side]]''.<ref name="Hasbro" />
